answers.core: GDScript is under constant changes and improvements. This kind of tool would work best if updated accordingly to the latest updates. Thus, being part of the core would be desirable.
answers.workaround: It should be used fairly often by any coders with some experience. There is a third-party solution, however: [Godot GDScript toolkit](https://github.com/Scony/godot-gdscript-toolkit).

title: Add a GDScript code formatter in the script editor
